entities.summary: The flash and circle is a symbol originally associated with fascism, first adopted in 1935 by the British Union of Fascists (BUF). Although rooted in fascist ideology, variations of the symbol have subsequently been used by non-fascist political parties and organisations in different parts of the world. Flash and circle is a symbol. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
